user_saw: Possibly extra layout work and sluggish typing at the end of a long, height-capped draft in browsers without native textarea content sizing; no visible misbehavior was reported.
summary: The composer autosizer now remembers the draft that proved it exceeds the height cap and skips scrollHeight and overflow measurements while text is only appended, invalidating on replacement, shrink, resize or scheduled layout changes, and drops the old geometry-based max-height shortcut.
reasoning: This is a performance improvement of measured autosizing that was never faster: the repeated layout reads were the long-standing behavior (related issue #154271 and superseded PR #154272 predate it, and the PR says the cost remained 'even after #186874'), and no commit is shown to have made appending slower. The PR states it changes measurement work, not appearance.
